summary: Phase 8.4 (Store Manager Panel) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (100%) including RBAC (401/403), /store/me, /store/dashboard shape, /store/orders list+filter, /store/orders/{id} 404, /store/drivers, /store/products (with low_stock filter), and full assign-rider flow with GET-verification. Frontend: After a one-time `supervisorctl restart expo` (Metro had a stale bundle that returned Unmatched Route for /store/* on initial load), all store screens work — login as manager@dwaarit.com routes to /store/dashboard, KPI grid renders with real data (₹139 revenue, 6 pending, 1 in-progress, 0 riders online), /store/orders lists 23 orders with status filters, tapping a card opens /store/order/{id}, /store/drivers, /store/inventory, /store/account all render, and Sign Out returns to /login. RBAC on frontend confirmed — customer (demo@dwaarit.com) navigating to /store/dashboard is redirected to /home. All role-routing regressions PASS: customer→/home, admin→/admin/orders, rider→/rider/dashboard, manager→/store/dashboard. No red screens, no API errors during the flow.

issues: No testID attributes on interactive elements (Pressables, KPI cards, filter chips, order cards, accept/assign buttons, modal rider rows). Makes future automated testing brittle — relied on text matching.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings throughout the app (not Phase 8.4 specific): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Likely originate from a shared component. Reference: app-wide.

action_items: Add testID props to all interactive elements on /store screens (dashboard KPI cards, filter chips, order cards, Accept/Assign/Mark preparing buttons, rider rows in modal, Sign out) so future testing agents can use stable selectors instead of text.
Optional polish: migrate legacy `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` and `Image style.resizeMode` to `props.resizeMode` in the shared components to silence deprecation warnings.

Operational note: Metro is running with CI=true (no watch). After adding new route files under /app/frontend/app/store/, an `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` was required for the routes to be served — without it /store/* returned 'Unmatched Route'. Consider documenting this or enabling watch mode in dev.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/store/* RBAC is correctly enforced via require_store_manager dependency — customer/rider tokens get 403, missing token gets 401.
Frontend /store/_layout.tsx correctly redirects non-managers (customer→/(tabs)/home, rider→/rider/dashboard); admins are allowed in (intentional per code).
/store/order/[id].tsx assign-rider flow correctly calls StoreApi.assignRider then reloads order; backend confirmed via GET that driver_id & driver_status='assigned' persist.
useStoreToken hook duplicates the secureGet logic from AuthContext (key 'dwaarit.auth.token'). Same pattern is used for rider portal — consider unifying.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded users (manager@dwaarit.com, demo@dwaarit.com, admin@dwaarit.com, rider@dwaarit.com) and existing seeded store/orders/drivers/products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8.4 fully working. Store backend endpoints live under /api/store/* (assign endpoint is /assign-rider, not /assign as the original request mentioned). Frontend store routes are file-based at /app/frontend/app/store/{dashboard,orders,drivers,inventory,account,order/[id]}.tsx with tabs in _layout.tsx. If routes start returning 'Unmatched Route' after adding files, restart expo via supervisorctl. Test creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: On the very first frontend test pass, /store/dashboard redirected the manager to /admin/orders and /store/drivers|inventory|account returned 'Unmatched Route'. Root cause: Metro bundler was running in CI mode without watch (per expo.out.log: 'Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled'). The store/*.tsx files had been added after Metro started, so they were not in the bundled route manifest — falling back to web 404 / nearest match. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`. After restart, all 7 store flows + 4 role-routing regressions passed cleanly. No code change required.
